artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing upright with long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, and visible cheekbones. They wear draped garments cinched at the waist, with one hand holding the edge of their garment and the other resting across their chest. The figure wears sandals and the background shows a pastoral landscape with trees, shrubs, and buildings, including a tower, set against a distant hill.

artworks.title: The Young Courier
artworks.medium: black crayon and gray wash on laid paper; gray wash figure on verso
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person depicted in a sketchy, fluid style. The person is in an active pose, appearing to be in motion with one leg forward and one leg back, arms extended outward. Their facial features are outlined with prominent eyes and an open mouth. The person's hair is short, curly, and flowing backward. They are dressed in loose, flowing garments detailed with shadows. The background is minimalistic with a lightly sketched ground and empty space around the figure. There is no visible jewelry, and the focus is on the motion and form of the individual.

artworks.title: Hercules and Nessus
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a centaur. The image shows a centaur engaged in a confrontation with a nude figure. The figure is mounted on the centaur and is holding a weapon with one hand and gripping the centaur's hair with the other hand. The scene includes a barren tree and a flowing ribbon with a Latin phrase above the central figure. The drawing uses detailed line work to show musculature and movement, and features a classical mythological theme typical in renaissance artworks.

artworks.title: Allegory of Life
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with two central figures and various mythical creatures throughout. The central figure on the left is draped in flowing robes near a gnarled tree, amidst a landscape with exotic animals and mythical beasts like dragons and unicorns. To the right, a warrior-like figure stands under a palm tree holding a spear. The background contains a cityscape including buildings, bridges, and paths. Swirling clouds and water add to the atmosphere, with tiny cherub-like figures in the upper sections.

artworks.title: Antwerp Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate etching of a Gothic cathedral, viewed from ground level looking upwards. The cathedral's tower is prominent, with detailed tracery and pointed arches defining its architecture. The horizon is low, revealing the cityscape with the cathedral at the center. Various smaller buildings and street life surround the cathedral. The etching's precise line work captures the cathedral's ornate details and stone textures. The color palette is monochrome, using varying shades of gray to create depth and contrast. People, horses, and carts are depicted in the foreground, providing scale against the cathedral. The cityscape continues in the background with rooftops and distant buildings fading away. Clouds fill the sky, adding a dramatic backdrop to the scene.

artworks.title: Two Peasants Fighting
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.3 x 6.6 cm (2 7/8 x 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures engaged in physical interaction in an outdoor setting. The sketch shows the two individuals entangled in a complex physical exchange, with various personal items like a hat, a stick, and a coat scattered on the ground around them. The background includes a simple landscape with grass and a rock or low hill. The illustration is done in a style characterized by detailed linework that conveys texture and movement.

artworks.title: Arearea no Varua Ino (Words of the Devil) [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor monotype on Japan paper, mounted to tan cardboard on whose verso is a fragment of another print

artworks.title: Horses Exercising
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses exercising with a rider. Two horses adorned with checkered blankets are guided by a rider. They are trotting in a space with brick walls in the background and a flat surface underfoot. The shading and texture add realism to the scene. The lines suggest movement and vitality. The rider is depicted in horse riding attire.

artworks.title: Rinaldo, Astride Baiardo, Flies Off in Pursuit of Angelica
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash and touches of pen andbrown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing of a flying figure on a horse over a landscape. The top left shows a celestial or mythological figure gesturing energetically downwards. Below, a mounted rider on a rearing horse charges through the air. The landscape consists of rough, jagged forms suggestive of rocky terrain or mountains, with swirling foliage or clouds around the horse and rider. The composition conveys movement and drama, emphasized by light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a print showing a robed man encountering a demonic creature in a detailed landscape. The man is on the left, facing the demonic creature on the right. The man has pale skin, long, curling hair, a short beard, a straight nose, and pronounced cheekbones. He wears a draping cloth garment with only his hands visible. The demonic creature has horns, wings, large ears, the feet of a bird, a long tail, and sharp spines on its nose and chin. On its body are the faces of animals, like a bird, a lion, and a wolf. In the background, there is a forest to the left and a rocky hill on the right. Between them is a city or castle in the distance, surrounded by hills and cliffs. The ground below the man and creature is covered with grass and rocks, and the sky above is blank.

artworks.title: Leda and the Swan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene featuring a partially destroyed rotunda and surrounding landscape. The scene includes a large, rounded architectural structure with arches, resembling a rotunda, appearing partially destroyed and overgrown with foliage. In front of the structure, there is a seated, nude figure surrounded by small winged beings and large birds. The landscape includes lush vegetation, a body of water with swans, and distant hills. The drawing has a detailed, almost engraver-like quality, focusing on line work and meticulous attention to architectural and natural details.

artworks.title: The Races (Les courses)
artworks.description: The image displays a busy scene from an elevated viewpoint. A wide avenue is filled with figures and carriages. In the background, there are trees and a spire-like structure. Brushstrokes are dynamic, capturing movement and energy. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of grey and black. Figures and horses are sketched with swirling lines, creating a sense of activity.

artworks.title: Battle of the Sea Gods [left half]
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing featuring mythological figures interacting with sea creatures in a dynamic scene. The composition shows muscular figures holding tridents or other tools, intertwined with fantastical sea creatures and horse-like beings emerging from the water. The figures are depicted in motion, surrounded by waves, aquatic life, shells, and seaweed. The artwork is characterized by intricate line work and cross-hatching, creating detailed textures and a strong sense of movement.

artworks.title: Cupid carrying a fowl accompanied by a dog, and another cupid playing a trumpet
artworks.description: The drawing shows two cherubs in a landscape. The cherubs are depicted in a pastoral scene, with one holding a small bird and the other playing a flute-like instrument. A small dog is present between them. The background includes a tree, hills, and flowing lines indicating water. The texture and shading add depth to the image, creating a serene setting.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 x 1.5 cm (2 9/16 x 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue-like figure. The drawing depicts a nude, standing human figure presented in a frontal view with an intricate headpiece. The legs are crossed as the figure stands upon a textured platform. There are serpentine shapes flanking the figure's torso, adding an element of mystique to the composition. The overall effect emphasizes classical and mythological influences. The use of shading and line work imbues the image with depth, suggesting a three-dimensional form within the constraints of the small, rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Hope
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in profile, facing right. The individual has folded arms, delicate facial features, and medium-length hair. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with a textured appearance. In the background, there is a decorative ribbon-like element with writing. The setting is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Head of a Girl with Curly Hair
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's profile, facing right. She has delicate facial features, with a straight nose and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled intricately. She is dressed in classical attire with a ribbon or banner around her head that reads "SOT." and "WENZ.". The background is dark, emphasizing the woman and the banner. No accessories or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Saint
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. They are facing forward with one hand raised to their chest. The person has detailed facial features, long wavy hair flowing past their shoulders, and a crown or halo. They are wearing a long robe with intricate folds. The background is plain, providing contrast to the detailed figure. The image is rendered in a monochromatic style, emphasizing line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: engraving heightened with white and yellow on green prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling and holding a child in the lower right portion. She wears a robe and a halo around her head and the child's head. The surroundings feature architectural details, a man observing from a building, an angel, and a cow peeking through a gate. In the upper portion, angels, a shining star, and smaller depictions of armored figures are visible within arches. The color scheme is muted blue and gray.

artworks.title: Jezebel Promising Naboth's Vineyard to King Ahab
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing next to a bed. The woman is in a side profile, facing right, leaning on the bed. She has a detailed woodcut-style face, with a veil or head covering and a long gown. An older man with a beard and cap is in the bed, looking out. The room includes a large canopy bed, a curtain, and small framed pictures on the wall.

artworks.title: Allegory of Fortitude (?)
artworks.description: The image features a mix of shapes and lines, such as vertical columns, circular domes, and detailed figures. The composition includes statuesque figures and architectural elements resembling a classical cityscape. There is a central spiraled column and a dome structure similar to ancient Roman architecture. A figure on horseback is in front, while a reclining figure beside a lion-like creature is present. There are towering columns and elaborate facades reminiscent of ancient temples or monuments. The overall composition blends the structural and symbolic elements, creating an abstract interpretation of a mythological or historical scene.

artworks.title: The Episode of the Falling Idol
artworks.description: The image shows an eye-level view of a pathway surrounded by tall, textured trees forming a canopy. In the center, an older man leads a donkey carrying a woman with a child. Beside them is a headless statue on a pedestal, partially hidden by vegetation. The background is filled with foliage, distant tree-tops, and slight architectural features. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, using a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Cottages and Barn beside a Road
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a thatched-roof building to the right. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky with soft clouds. Surrounding the building are trees, a fence, and subtle brushstrokes adding texture. The color palette consists of sepia tones. In the distance to the left, faint structures can be seen on the horizon. The land close by has gentle brush marks, with a small body of water reflecting light.

artworks.title: The States General of France (Les Etats Generaux de France)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial hall. The scene shows a grand, ornately decorated hall with a high, vaulted ceiling adorned with intricate patterns and two large crests. The composition is symmetrical with a central aisle flanked by rows of figures in lavish attire. The hall leads towards a focal area in the distance where more elaborately dressed figures are gathered. The architectural elements include decorative columns, archways, and detailed ornamental work. The ceiling features depictions of allegorical figures amidst clouds. The overall tone is one of splendor and formality.
